text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly brought the injured Narita Top 
Road to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... I apologize. I got a little too 
far ahead of myself......

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I really do need to rest, don't I? It's 
okay, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, can I help with anything? Even like 
this, if there's anything I can do...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Filing documents, carrying luggage, 
anything! As long as I can move my body, 
even just a little!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise... I just end up overthinking 
all sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm... still not good enough, am I? Even 
after saying I'd be fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I will make up for this setback once I 
return. ...I swear it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though tinged with frustration, Narita Top 
Road devoted herself to treatment...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much! Well then, 
without further ado—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I thought I could make it. 
...Slow and steady wins the race, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After administering quick first aid, I had 
the pained Narita Top Road rest up...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, finished typing up the 
post-return training menu!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, you've always been preparing 
all of this entirely on your own, haven't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Once I'm back in peak condition, please 
let me help out with even more things!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road helped out within 
reasonable limits and deepened her 
knowledge of training!
